# QYL0106: Orphaned [TracedTag]

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `OpenTelemetry` |
| Code fix | Yes |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0106OrphanedTracedTagAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

The [TracedTag] attribute is only meaningful when used on parameters of methods that participate in tracing via [Traced]. When neither the method nor its declaring type has [Traced], the tag will be silently ignored and becomes dead metadata.
